title: A temporary table: its name does not replace shared context
goal: Materialize two own requests, reconcile 75 and end the temporary-table context.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P6. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: One query created a table, but another cannot find it. The name alone is insufficient: which manager owns the prepared set, and when is it closed?
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Intermediate sets need contracts
paragraphs: A temporary table stores intermediate results within an execution context and can support reuse. It is not a persistent catalog. Specify fields, keys and expected multiplicity. Materializing all columns or all source rows can hurt performance; select only required data with justified filtering.
Create a local TempTablesManager. The first query stores only references and minutes of the own customer in СвоиЗаявки. This is not permanent metadata or a global multi-user cache.

paragraphs: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.

paragraphs: The first query places two own requests in СвоиЗаявки. The second uses the same manager and gets 2 rows/ 75 minutes. After Закрыть, a further query must refuse. This concerns resource lifetime, not deletion of documents.

sections.title: Virtual tables compute a view
paragraphs: Balance, Turnovers andSliceLast expose register semantics. Period and dimension parameters participate in the computation. Filtering afterwards is not always semantically or operationally equivalent to a virtual-table parameter. Establish correctness on a small set before comparing plans and measurements.

Assign the same manager to the second query so it sees the temporary table and returns two facts/75. An equal table name does not transfer context. Separate field/row provenance from the final aggregation.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Will a new manager automatically see another manager’s СвоиЗаявки?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. The query’s МенеджерВременныхТаблиц establishes the context. Identical query text does not transfer prepared rows to another manager. Closing the owner ends access to its tables.

sections.title: Manager lifetime
paragraphs: A shared temporary-table manager can expose an intermediate set to multiple queries. Another query without that context need not see it. A global manager is not an eternal cache of other users’data. Define creation, use and disposal; repeat tests from a known state.

Close the manager after reading. A controlled subsequent access must fail, proving the context ended. Production cleanup must also handle exceptions; this experiment covers the normal path and explicit later failure, not all server failures.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Each arrow either establishes, uses, or ends resource access. Documents remain in the infobase. The independent task separately checks another context and a filtered single row.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Copying the aggregate query text without sharing its manager leaves the table absent in that context. Creating a permanent catalog with a similar name does not repair the contract.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Test stages separately
paragraphs: First reconcile temporary rows with source data, then final aggregation with an independent total. For virtual tables, test before the first movement and at a change boundary. Include empty sets. Faster execution with different identities or values is not a valid optimization.

The module 6 virtual table computes register semantics over time/dimensions; a temporary table stores a prepared set within a context. Compare purposes. Materialization alone does not prove faster execution.

paragraphs: From new 20-minute and 40-minute requests, place only durations >= 30 in МойОтбор. The owning manager must return 1 row/40. Another manager must refuse, while the first still works. After closing the first, its query must refuse too.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain how a temporary table differs from a permanent object and a register’s virtual table.
